maddeler.e:
تزدلفون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَلِفُونَ (tazdalifūna) /taz.da.li.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# تُزْدَلَفُونَ (tuzdalafūna) /tuz.da.la.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
